title: GenesisAeon/aeon-ai: v1.0.0 – Real-time Phase-Transition Detection and Native Self-Reflection Loop
description: aeon-ai v1.0.0 is the self-reflective mirror-based AeonAI framework for the GenesisAeon stack: real-time phase-transition detection (PhaseDetector, UTAC-Logistic trigger, collapse detection) and a native closed-loop self-reflection engine (SelfReflector, max 7 iterations, CREP-Lagrangian-Sigillin coupling). Part of the GenesisAeon ecosystem (P-AI-CORE, domain: AI core engine / Mirror-Machine self-reflection). Source code is licensed GPL-3.0-or-later; documentation is licensed CC BY 4.0.
